steps.action: Set the device font to its largest size, then do "Receipts".
user_sees: Bigger text that wraps; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

user_sees: Title 'Receipt <number>' with the member’s name and the day under it
Buttons 'Back', 'Send on WhatsApp', 'Print'
must_not: A receipt of another member
The words 'Receipt not found' for a payment just saved

user_sees: Heading 'Payment receipt' (or 'Tax invoice' when the gym had a GST number on the payment day)
'Received with thanks from' and the member’s name
'<Plan> membership' with '<first day> to <last day>' as sold
The amount, and in words like 'Rupees One Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Nine Only'
'Balance on this membership as on <today>:' with what is still due
'Computer-generated receipt. Valid without a signature.'
'Received by' the name of the person who took the money
must_not: Words that do not match the figures
Free days given later printed as days paid for
GST worked out at today’s rate for an old payment
Today's GST number on a payment taken before the gym had one

user_sees: The browser’s print window with only the receipt sheet
must_not: The buttons or the menu printed on the paper
A different number on a second print
Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach
